title: Procedure (skeleton)
description: A blank procedure with the sections a procedure cannot be approved without: purpose, scope, steps and roles.

facts.label: Parent policy
facts.description: The policy this document implements, by title and reference.

facts.label: Document owner role
facts.description: The role accountable for this document.

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.content: This procedure describes how the requirements of {{fact:parent_policy_reference}} are carried out.
sections.guidance: Say which requirement this procedure carries out.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.content: This procedure applies whenever the activity it describes is performed within the scope of {{fact:parent_policy_reference}}.
sections.guidance: When the procedure applies, and when it does not.

sections.heading: Procedure
sections.content:
1. Describe the first step. Each step must name who performs it and what record it leaves.
2. Describe the next step.
sections.guidance: Numbered, role-assigned, repeatable steps. Each step says who does it and what evidence it leaves.

sections.heading: Roles and responsibilities
sections.content: The {{fact:document_owner_role}} owns this procedure and must keep it current.
